cards.title: Lingling has deals to make your shopping experience feel great!
cards.detailDescription:
Exclusive privileges for Bangkok Bank M Visa credit cardholders
when shopping in department stores. The Mall Lifestyle Stores, all branches, The Mall Korat, Emporium, EmQuartier, EmSphere and Paragon subject to specified conditions

# Shop every Friday, Saturday and Sunday and redeem M Cash Coupons totaling up to 7,600 baht (1) (2)
Dates: May 1, 2026 – May 3, 2026, May 8, 2026 – May 10, 2026, May 15, 2026 - May 17, 2026, May 22, 2026 - May 24, 2026
• Spending amount 2,000 baht - 9,999 baht receive M Cash Coupon:
M Card receives 100 baht + Bangkok Bank M Visa receives M Cash Coupon 100 baht (limited to a total of 4,800 rights)

• Spending amount 10,000 baht - 24,999 baht receive M Cash Coupon:
M Card 600 baht Baht + Bangkok Bank M Visa 600 Baht (limited to a total of 1,200 rights)

• Spending amount 25,000 Baht - 49,999 Baht receive M Cash Coupon :
M Card 1,700 Baht + Bangkok Bank M Visa 1,700 Baht (limited to a total of 420 rights)

• Spending amount 50,000 Baht or more receive M Cash Coupon :
M Card 3,800 Baht + Bangkok Bank M Visa 3,800 Baht (limited to a total of 10 rights)
Only for Bangkok Bank M Legend and Bangkok Bank M Luxe credit cards

#Shop every Monday - Thursday and redeem E-Coupon 50%(3)
when shopping 1,000 Baht or more/sales slip and redeem 1,000 M Points to receive E-coupon 500 Baht.
Register to receive E-Coupon at the Inspector point at the designated department store. and receive benefits through M Card App

#M Card members every day receive an additional 400 baht Cash Coupon (4)
when accumulating shopping totals of 2,000 baht or more / day (excluding Power Mall and Gourmet Market). Show the receipt at the Inspector point on the same day and at the same branch.

The rights are limited, conditions are as specified by the department store and the bank.
Please check additional conditions at the point of sale and other media of the department store.
cards.responsibleLendingDisclaimerText: Use only what you need and repay in full on time to avoid the 16% interest charge.
